# Testing Report

**Date:** 2026-11-17  **Environment:** Ubuntu 24, Python 3.12.3, standard library only
**Scope:** Synthetic logs generated by `tools/generate_sample_logs.py` (seed 42) on RFC 5737 documentation IP ranges. No real systems or third parties were tested.

## 1. Summary
| Item | Result |
|---|---|
| Automated tests | **23 / 23 passed** (`python -m unittest discover -s tests`) |
| Sample dataset | 422 events (44 SSH, 353 web, 25 firewall) |
| Pipeline result | 11 alerts -> 3 incidents (2 CRITICAL, 1 HIGH) |
| Simulated attackers detected | 3 / 3 |
| False positives on benign hosts (192.0.2.0/24, 300+ requests, 3 SSH events incl. typo logins) | 0 |
| Throughput | 200,000 web-log lines parsed and analysed in 2.1 s |

## 4. Sensitivity / tuning checks
| Run | Result |
|---|---|
| SSH log only, defaults | 1 CRITICAL incident (203.0.113.50), exit 2 |
| `--ssh-fail-threshold 50 --enum-users-threshold 50` | 0 alerts, exit 0 - thresholds work as intended |
| `--allowlist 203.0.113.50` | 0 alerts, exit 0 |

## 5. Limitations and honest caveats
- Results come from **synthetic** data designed alongside the rules, so 100% detection here shows the logic works, not that real-world accuracy is 100%. Run against real lab logs (see section 6) before claiming more.
- Python 3.12 was tested locally; the 3.9-3.12 matrix runs in GitHub Actions after you push.
- "Low and slow" attacks below thresholds are not detected; shared NAT addresses can merge unrelated users into one incident; IPv6 is not parsed.
- Web signatures are pattern-based and can be evaded by encoding tricks beyond single URL-decoding.

## 6. Recommended real-lab validation (authorised systems only)
1. Create a lab VM you own (e.g. Ubuntu with sshd + nginx + iptables logging).
2. From a second VM you own, generate traffic: `nmap -sS <lab-ip>` (port scan), a few dozen wrong SSH logins, `nikto -h http://<lab-ip>` or manual requests with `' OR 1=1--`.
3. Copy `/var/log/auth.log`, nginx `access.log` and the kernel log to the analyser and run LogSentinel.
4. Paste the console output and a dashboard screenshot below, and note any missed or false detections.
